decision_rule: Do not admit a hidden-envelope objective unless response_hidden beats both reset_hidden and current_response across repeated split seeds, probe seeds, and braking/lateral/yaw targets.
failure_criteria: response_hidden only beats reset_hidden but not current_response
single split or single probe seed is used for admission
the objective changes deployable actor inputs or adds hidden physics to actor inference
behavior-retention gates are skipped after objective movement
hypothesis: M109 showed current_response often beats carried response_hidden. A useful self-identification hidden state must add information beyond the current response frame, not merely differ from reset hidden.
success_criteria: objective or prototype explicitly gates response_hidden against current_response and reset_hidden
repeated split and multi-seed metrics are reported
no hidden/oracle actor inputs are added
behavior retention remains a required follow-up gate before PPO continuation
